en: This postcard features a black and white photograph of a river scene with several small sailboats and rowboats lining the banks. Prominent in the background is a large Gothic-style church with a tall spire and visible clock, and surrounding historical buildings. There is some text on the front identifying the location. The reverse side shows handwritten correspondence, a postage stamp from Sweden (Sverige), and recipient information.
